==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Lieutenant Langmar
:''"Our scouts report that a Charr Legionnaire named Blazefiend Griefblade is amassing forces for his Warband in the Northlands. We're not sure what he is up to, but we do know we would be better off with one less Charr commander this close to Ascalon City! If you think you have what it takes to challenge the Charr, head to the Northlands. Don't travel alone, though. We will not allow lone travelers to cross the wall."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = A dead Charr is a good Charr!
| decline = That sounds pretty dangerous. Count me out!
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Blazefiend Griefblade
:''"What happens here does not matter. You and all of your kin are doomed!"''

===Reward dialogue===
;Lieutenant Langmar
:''"We have struck a great blow against the charr today. I'd like to see them try to top that!"''


[[Category:Vanguard quests|Blazefiend Griefblade]]

== Trivia ==
*The intermediate dialogue foreshadows [[the Searing]].
*The accept phrase "A dead Charr is a good Charr!" is a rephrased aphorism ''"The only good Indian is a dead Indian"'', which is usually attributed to U.S. general [[w:Philip Sheridan|Philip Sheridan]].
*If Blazefiend Griefblade is killed quickly enough, his dialogue "What happens here does not matter. You and all of your kin are doomed!" will instead be said by another Charr in the area.
